features:
### ⚔️ Combat Tab

* Hit All (Skills): Instantly teleports your projectiles directly into the enemy's body for guaranteed hits (Supports Gojo, Akainu, Ichigo TS, Grimmjow, Joseph, Gaara, Josuke, Kazuma, Super Dummy).

* Auto Black Flash: Automatically hits perfect timing for Black Flash characters (Yuji, Sukuna, Toji, etc.).

* Nanami Perfect Flash: Always hits the 7:3 ratio perfectly.

* Auto Kokushibo Timing: Hits the perfect timing for his crescent moon slashes.

* Auto Tengen Osu: Automatically plays and perfectly hits Tengen's rhythm game.

* Auto M1 Trade Engine: Automatically blocks and counters enemy M1 attacks. Includes Ping Compensation and Hold Block Time adjustments.

* Guard Break Safety: Stops blocking if your guard is about to break (based on a customizable percentage).

* Face Check: Only trades M1s if the enemy is actually looking at you.

* Micro-Teleport Evasive: Quickly dodges backwards to escape when you take damage.

* Anti-Stun Mode: Removes all stun and ragdoll effects from your character.

* Lock-On System: Locks your camera onto the nearest enemy (Customizable keybind, optionally ignores teammates).

* Macro System: Record, play, save, import, and export custom movement and attack macros. Active macros highlight in your saved library.

### 🏃 Player Tab

* Silent Fly: Allows you to fly seamlessly (with adjustable speed and mobile UI dock support).

* Accurate Speed Hack: Increases your walk speed safely without triggering anti-cheats.

* High-Jump: Boosts your jump height.

* Noclip Mode: Lets you walk through solid walls and objects.

* TP Nearest Player Key: Press a custom keybind (Default: T) to instantly teleport 3 studs in front of the nearest player while automatically turning to face them.

* Passives: Grants you passive dodge/float abilities from other characters (Wuxian Dodges, Mob Dodge, Geppo, Flashstep, MUI Dodge, Vigilante Float).

* No Cooldown Dashes: Spams dash auras without cooldowns to deal massive damage (Bakugo Dodge, Natsu TP).

* Troll Features: Rainbow Skin, Spin Bot, T-Pose, and Fake Lag (freezes you in mid-air).

* Waypoints: Save your current position and instantly teleport back to it anytime.

* Instant Self-Kill: Resets your character instantly.

* Hazard Removals: Makes you completely immune to Deidara Mines, Tobi Traps, Akainu/Gray Pools, Giorno Flowers, and Solar Flare blindness. Can also freeze all character animations.

### 👁️ Visuals Tab

* Elite 2D-Box ESP: Draws boxes around enemies and shows their Name, Health, Awakening (Ult) Bar

* Trap ESP: Highlights hidden Deidara Mines and Tobi Traps in the map.

* Streamer Mode: Hides all player names to protect identities while recording.

* Graphics Modifiers: Fullbright (max lighting), No Fog, No Atmosphere.

* FPS Boosters: Removes map decals, particles, and shadows to maximize your framerate.

* Field of View (FOV): Custom slider to adjust your camera's FOV.

* Server Options: Quick Rejoin, Server Hop (finds servers that aren't full), and Reset Character.
